question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.**

__He will be looking__ as if he has not slept.
solution:
The correct answer is: **He looks**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in the future continuous tense ("**will be looking**"). This tense suggests an ongoing action in the future.
 
• However, the key here is the use
